explication: ClipWallet is a keyboard-driven macOS clipboard manager with persistent static slots and a recency-based dynamic ring. The principal workflow is: a user chord is detected and dispatched to the engine, which captures or selects typed clipboard data, updates in-memory state, synchronizes paste data, and periodically persists state. The README also documents encrypted vault operations, rich clipboard formats, daemon management, and status commands. Several command routes and implementation details are only partially sampled, so those links are omitted where the shown evidence does not establish them.
